r13_contract.comparisonModel: Use the controlled 12.3.1 matrix selectors. Each represented crew member must have exactly one controlled role and the ship exactly one controlled ice condition and ship type. The linked training record requiredTrainingLevel must equal trainingRecordLevel and stcwQualificationValid must be true whenever the matrix requires Basic or Advanced training. For an Ice-free or other not-applicable matrix cell, requiredTrainingLevel is polarTrainingNotApplicable and no matching STCW training record is required solely by 12.3.1.
r13_contract.tableModel: MSC.385(94) 12.3.1: Ice free -> Not applicable for Tankers, Passenger ships and Other. Open waters -> Basic for master/chief mate/OICNW on Tankers and Passenger ships; Not applicable for Other. Other waters -> Advanced for master/chief mate and Basic for OICNW for all ship groups.
